reason: Primary publisher full-text extract describes MELA for remote-sensing image super-resolution, combining a Mamba cross-scan layer and local window attention. It evaluates image reconstruction on four remote-sensing datasets and states efficiency as a vision-model design goal; no language model or LLM-serving workload is evaluated. The claimed efficiency is specific to image restoration, so this is unrelated to LLM inference efficiency.
title: Mamba-enhanced local attention network for remote sensing image super-resolution
